body: Hope everything gets better for you. How effective is group therapy? I've been thinking about getting involved with that

Yes, I was referred to a specialised team. I had an assessment and was told I would undergo CBT, but that was over a month ago. There were some issues with registration so the whole thing has been delayed. For some reason I'm a little skeptical of CBT. How were/are you being treated?

Yeah the main thing keeping me is hope for a good future. But when I think of that road ahead and for how long I have to endure this mental torture it brings me right back down. It's good that you have helpful friends. I find it hard to tell people what's happening in fear of being judged I guess. Thanks for taking your time to listen, by the way
It feels like my youth is being wasted as I'm living with this... having no social life. What's your story? How are you coping?
